g_policy.reason: The offer copy states the 30-minute reward before the optional game. The decline and ad-failure fields leave the app unchanged if the reader declines or the play cannot be confirmed.

g_no_cash.reason: The reward is 30 minutes without sponsored stories, not cash or anything exchangeable outside the app.

g_no_chat_content.reason: The trigger event uses a return to the home feed and an article-open counter, not chat content.

g_no_free_removal.reason: The adds and reward fields introduce an optional, temporary way to hide sponsored cards; they do not lock or cap a free reading feature.

g_brand_safety.reason: The placement is a banner on s01 Home · Top Stories, which the product model rates content safe; it is not inside a conversation.

c1_revealed_value.reason: As a product change, the 30-minute cleaner reading window benefits the player in the observed story-reading flow f01.

c2_evidence.reason: The what makes it work here field says the app has no paywall, limit, or currency, but the open question says only that none was seen on the home feed. That field also calls the cards low-value, and the subscribers field concludes every reader is free; neither claim about the app today is supported by the model.

c3_spares_payers.reason: The product model shows no paid plan, and the offered to field limits the banner to free users.

c4_protects_subscription.reason: The reward expires after 30 minutes, and the proposal does not take an unsold advantage from other users or creators.

c5_moment.reason: The trigger event places the offer after the reader returns to the feed from an article, rather than interrupting an article in progress.

c6_fits_simula.reason: The flow uses a short sponsored game and grants the reward only once the play is confirmed; the article-open counter is a detectable app event.

c7_specific.reason: The placement and reward refer to this app's category pills and sponsored cards in the home feed and articles, shown by s01.e44 and s02.e13.

other_concern: The proposal assumes a game will offset the revenue from hidden sponsored cards; the model gives no revenue data to test that prediction.
